info.title: CIA Internal API
info.description: Internal REST API for the Core Insurance Application — staff, System Auditors, and system-to-system use. Authentication via Keycloak JWT (Bearer token). All endpoints require `isAuthenticated()`; fine-grained access uses module-level roles.

bearerJwt.description: Keycloak RS256 JWT. Obtain via Keycloak login at your tenant realm.

ChartOfAccountNode.description: Chart-of-accounts node returned by GET /finance/chart-of-accounts. Recursive — leaves carry an empty children array.

ifrs17Role.description: IFRS 17 measurement role tag (null on non-measurement leaves).

ifrs9Role.description: IFRS 9 classification role tag (null on non-investment leaves).

JournalEntryLineRequest.description: One leg of a POST /finance/journal-entries request. Exactly one of debitAmount / creditAmount must be > 0; the other must be 0.

accountCode.description: COA leaf code; resolved server-side to the account id.

cohortYear.description: IFRS 17 cohort year (Slice 2.x). Null in Slice 1.4.

dimensionTags.description: Free-form analytic tags persisted as JSONB.

PostJournalEntryRequest.description: Wire contract for POST /finance/journal-entries. The service stamps postingDate=today (D5 default); callers cannot override it.

businessDate.description: Economic event date. Drives period assignment via FiscalPeriodResolver and the 5-business-day late-posting cut-off (Slice 1.7).

sourceReference.description: Idempotency key (forms UNIQUE triple with sourceModule + sourceEventType). For manual postings, use a fresh UUID-derived value (D8).

ReverseJournalEntryRequest.description: Wire contract for POST /finance/journal-entries/{id}/reverse. The reason is appended to the auto-built reversal narrative.

reason.description: Audit trail justification. Appears in the reversal entry narrative as 'REVERSAL of JE {originalId}: {reason}'.

JournalEntryLineResponse.description: Read model for one journal entry line, with COA fields surfaced alongside the id.

JournalEntryResponse.description: Posted journal entry with all of its lines. Returned by POST /finance/journal-entries, GET /finance/journal-entries/{id}, and POST /finance/journal-entries/{id}/reverse.

businessDate.description: Economic event date supplied by caller.

sourceEventType.description: On reversal entries this is the literal 'REVERSAL'.

sourceReference.description: On reversal entries this is the original JE id.

reversalOf.description: Non-null only on entries that themselves reverse an earlier JE.

TrialBalanceLine.description: One row of a trial balance. debitBalance / creditBalance are mutually exclusive (exactly one > 0; the other is 0).

TrialBalanceFooter.description: Aggregate footer attached to every TrialBalanceResponse (D3=A flat-list-plus-footer shape).

lineCount.description: Count of journal_entry_lines that contributed (not accounts).

TrialBalanceResponse.description: GET /finance/trial-balance?asOf= response. asOf is interpreted on business_date (D4=A) — cumulative since inception.

CreateFiscalYearRequest.description: Wire contract for POST /finance/fiscal-years. All three fields are optional (D1=A): omitting all yields the current-calendar-year FY. If supplied, startDate must be the first day of a month and endDate must be exactly 12 months minus one day later. Name defaults to FY{year} (d9).

FiscalPeriodResponse.description: One fiscal period — child of a FiscalYear, generated at FY create time (D2=A). MONTH/QUARTER/HALF_YEAR boundaries are FY-relative (d8). softClosedAt/hardClosedAt arrive via Slice 1.7 (PeriodLockService).

FiscalYearResponse.description: Fiscal year with optional embedded periods. periods is non-null only when ?includePeriods=true on GET or on POST (create returns the freshly-generated set).

PeriodLockResponse.description: Row from the V31 period_lock table. Type-2 SCD — released_at IS NULL = active lock; the full sequence of soft/hard/release rows IS the audit history.

graceWindowUntil.description: SOFT locks: 5 business days past lockedAt; HARD locks: null

LockReportEntry.description: One day's row in a /finance/period-locks/preview report. Bulk-operation callers use this to pre-check a date range.

idDocumentUrl.description: MinIO/S3 path to uploaded ID document

idExpiryDate.description: Required for Driver's Licence and Passport; must not be expired at onboarding

cacCertificateUrl.description: MinIO/S3 path to uploaded CAC certificate

type.description: SYSTEM reports are immutable; clone into CUSTOM to modify

config.description: ReportConfig JSONB: {fields, filters, groupBy, sortBy, sortDir, chart}

validityDays.description: Quote validity in days (printed on PDF)

typeId.description: ID of the discount/loading type from setup

format.description: Whether the value is a percentage or flat Naira amount

typeName.description: Denormalized type name at time of save

computedAmount.description: Calculated NGN amount based on format and base premium

rate.description: Premium rate as a percentage (e.g. 2.25 for 2.25%)

premium.description: Item net premium after loadings and discounts

quoteLoadings.description: Quote-level loadings applied on top of item nets

selectedClauseIds.description: IDs of clauses from the clause bank to attach to this quote

totalGrossPremium.description: Sum of all item gross premiums

totalNetPremium.description: Final net premium after all loadings and discounts

inputterName.description: Name of the underwriter who created the quote

approverName.description: Name of the approving officer (set on approval)

QuoteUpdateRequest.description: All fields optional — only provided fields are updated. Risks, if provided, replace all existing risk items.

tags.name: Audit Logs
tags.description: Search and view the full system audit trail across all modules

tags.name: Login & Session Logs
tags.description: Login, logout, and failed authentication event recording and retrieval

tags.name: Audit Alerts
tags.description: Real-time anomaly alerts — failed logins, bulk deletes, off-hours activity, large approvals

tags.name: Audit Configuration
tags.description: Alert thresholds and data retention settings (System Admin only for writes)

get.description: Returns all alerts or unacknowledged-only when `unacknowledgedOnly=true`. Ordered newest first.

post.description: Marks the alert as acknowledged. The acknowledging user is recorded.

get.description: Streams a CSV file containing audit log entries matching the supplied filters. All filters are optional.
Filterable by userId or date range. Requires AUDIT_VIEW or SETUP_UPDATE role.
Paginated, filterable audit trail. Filter by entityType, entityId, userId, action, or date range.

403.description: Insufficient role — requires AUDIT_VIEW or SETUP_UPDATE

get.description: All audit events for a specific entity type (module) in a date range.
All audit events performed by a specific user in a date range.
All APPROVE and REJECT events across every module in a date range.
Full before/after change history for a specific entity. Returns old_value and new_value JSONB snapshots.

200.description: Paginated change events with before/after snapshots

get.description: Login, logout, and failed authentication events in a date range.
Ranked list of all users by total action count in a date range.

post.description: **Public endpoint — no JWT required.** Called when JWT validation fails for a known user. Triggers failed-login alert detection.
Called by the frontend on logout. Requires a valid JWT.
Called by the frontend after successful Keycloak authentication. Requires a valid JWT.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all customers. Filterable by type (INDIVIDUAL/CORPORATE) and KYC status.

post.description: Creates a corporate customer record and triggers KYC (RC number verification + director ID checks). Accepts `multipart/form-data`. `cacCertificate` must be JPG or PNG, max 5 MB. `cacIssuedDate` is required. Each director's `idDocument` (indexed as `directorIdDocuments`) must be provided. Director `idExpiryDate[i]` is required and must not be expired for DRIVERS_LICENSE/PASSPORT.

directors[0].fullName.description: Repeat for each director with indexed fields

directors[0].idExpiryDate.description: Required for DRIVERS_LICENSE/PASSPORT. Must be ≥ today.

cacCertificate.description: CAC certificate — JPG or PNG, max 5 MB

directorIdDocuments.description: One file per director in the same order as directors[]. JPG or PNG, max 5 MB each

400.description: Validation error — e.g. expired director ID

post.description: Creates an individual customer record and triggers KYC verification. Accepts `multipart/form-data`. The `idDocument` file must be JPG or PNG, max 5 MB. `idExpiryDate` is **required and must not be expired** when `idType` is `DRIVERS_LICENSE` or `PASSPORT`.

idExpiryDate.description: Required for DRIVERS_LICENSE and PASSPORT. Must be ≥ today.

400.description: Validation error — e.g. expired ID document

get.summary: Search customers by name, email, or phone

put.summary: Update customer contact details, KYC, and directors

kycUpdateReason.description: Required when any KYC field changes

directors[N].id.description: Corporate: existing director ID (omit for new)

directors[N].kycUpdateReason.description: Required when director KYC fields change

directorDoc_N.description: Document for director at index N

400.description: Validation error — e.g. KYC reason missing, minimum 2 directors violated, expired ID

post.description: Re-runs KYC verification for a customer whose KYC status is FAILED or PENDING. Returns 422 if KYC has already passed.

get.summary: Pending approval counts by entity type
get.description: Returns the count of items in PENDING_APPROVAL status for each entity type across all modules.
Returns monthly premium written and claims incurred for the last 6 months, plus a computed loss ratio percentage per month. Used for the dashboard sparkline chart.

get.summary: Last 10 audit log entries across all modules
get.description: Returns the 10 most recent audit log entries from the system-wide audit trail, ordered by timestamp descending. Used for the Recent Activity feed on the dashboard.

get.summary: Policies expiring in the next 7 days
get.description: Returns one entry per day for the next 7 days, each with the count of ACTIVE policies whose end date falls on that day. Always returns exactly 7 entries; days with no renewals have count = 0.

get.summary: Global search across policies, claims, customers, and quotes
get.description: Case-insensitive ILIKE search across policies (by policy_number), claims (by claim_number), customers (by name), and quotes (by quote_number). Returns up to 5 results per entity type, capped at 20 total. Minimum query length is 2 characters.

Returns 8 aggregated KPIs for the back-office home screen: active policies, open claims, pending approvals, premiums MTD, claims reserve total, renewals due in 30 days, outstanding premium, and RI utilisation %.

Returns the seeded chart of accounts as a nested tree rooted at the five top-level account-type classes (Asset / Liability / Equity / Income / Expense). Children are sorted ascending by code; soft-deleted rows are omitted. Read-only — CRUD on the COA is deferred until tenant customisation (post-Phase-7). Introduced by Module 12 Slice 1.3.

post.description: Single authoritative path for inserting journal entries. Validates Σ debits == Σ credits, idempotency on (sourceModule, sourceEventType, sourceReference), fiscal period existence, and that every target COA account is active. Returns 201 with the saved JE + lines. Introduced by Module 12 Slice 1.4 (GATEWAY).

409.description: Conflict — idempotency triple already in use (JOURNAL_ENTRY_DUPLICATE)

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — unbalanced / inactive account / invalid line / fiscal period missing

get.summary: Read a journal entry by id

post.description: Records a mirror posting (debit ↔ credit) and transitions the original to REVERSED. The reversal itself is POSTED (D2=A). The single-reversal rule (d11) rejects reversing an already-reversed entry or a reversal entry. Active-account check is skipped on this path (d7) so a cleanup is always possible.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — already reversed or not POSTED

get.summary: Trial balance as of a business date
get.description: Cumulative-since-inception trial balance with asOf interpreted on journal_entry.business_date (D4=A). Returns a flat list per chart-of-account plus a footer summary (D3=A). Each row carries a balance on exactly one side (the netted side). Introduced by Module 12 Slice 1.4 (GATEWAY).
Returns every non-deleted fiscal year, newest first. Periods are not embedded; use GET /{id}?includePeriods=true or GET /{id}/periods. Introduced by Module 12 Slice 1.6.

post.description: Creates a fiscal year and immediately generates its 19 child periods (12 MONTH + 4 QUARTER + 2 HALF_YEAR + 1 YEAR, D2=A). All request fields are optional — omitting all yields the current-calendar-year FY (D1=A). Quarters and halves are FY-relative (d8). The new FY starts in PLANNING; activate it separately (D3=B).

409.description: Conflict — fiscal year name already exists

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — bounds violation (not month-aligned or not 12-month span)

get.description: Returns the single FiscalYear with status=ACTIVE. Throws 404 (FISCAL_YEAR_NO_ACTIVE) when no FY is currently active — e.g. before the tenant bootstrap has been called.

404.description: Not found — no fiscal year is currently ACTIVE

get.summary: Get a fiscal year by id

parameters.name: includePeriods
parameters.description: When true, embeds the 19 child periods in the response.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the fiscal year. Refused with 422 if any journal_entry rows reference its child periods — the GL is immutable history. Close the fiscal year via /close instead when it has financial activity.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — fiscal year has journal entries

get.summary: List child periods of a fiscal year

post.description: Flips a PLANNING fiscal year to ACTIVE. D3=B: refused with 422 (FISCAL_YEAR_ACTIVATION_CONFLICT) if any other FY is already ACTIVE — admin must explicitly close the prior FY first. Idempotent on an already-ACTIVE row; refused on CLOSED.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — another FY is ACTIVE or this FY is CLOSED

post.description: Flips an ACTIVE fiscal year to CLOSED. Period-level postings are governed independently by Slice 1.7 period_lock; closing the FY just retires the 'current year' badge so a successor can be activated.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — fiscal year is not ACTIVE

post.description: Flips a fiscal period from OPEN to SOFT_CLOSED and opens the 5-business-day grace window. Idempotent. Module 12 Slice 1.7.
Flips a fiscal period to HARD_CLOSED. Auto-soft-closes first to honour the ck_fiscal_period_close_chronology invariant. Idempotent. Module 12 Slice 1.7.
Releases the active HARD lock and flips status to REOPENED. Publishes PeriodReopenedEvent → CFO + compliance email. NAICOM-grade audit trail in period_lock + audit_log. Module 12 Slice 1.7.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — period is not HARD-closed

get.summary: Full lock history for a fiscal period
get.description: Returns every soft/hard/release row for the period in reverse chronological order. Auditor-facing evidence chain. Module 12 Slice 1.7.

get.summary: Preview lock status across a date range
get.description: Returns one LockReportEntry per business date so bulk operations (Module 8 bulk receipts, Slice 1.8 backfill, bordereaux) can pre-check before kicking off the workflow. Module 12 Slice 1.7.

post.description: Reverses an approved receipt. Requires reason. Creates a reversal audit trail.
Calculates the pro-rata premium adjustment for an endorsement without creating it.

post.summary: Bind a policy from an approved quote

post.description: Approves the policy, generates the PDF, creates the debit note, and triggers async NAICOM/NIID upload.
Signals the running Temporal workflow to retry the NAICOM upload, or starts a new workflow if none is running.
Creates a DRAFT quote with per-item loadings, discounts, and clause selection. Supports single-risk (one item) and multi-risk (multiple items).

get.description: Returns a paginated list of quotes. Filter by status or customerId.

200.description: Quote details including per-item loadings/discounts, clause IDs, inputterName, approverName

get.description: Generates and streams a PDF of the quote. Only available when status is APPROVED or CONVERTED.

400.description: Quote not in APPROVED or CONVERTED status

get.summary: List report access policies for an access group
get.description: System Admin only (`reports:manage_access`). Returns all category-level and report-level access policies for the specified group.

put.summary: Upsert a category-level or report-level access policy
put.description: Resolution order: report-level policy wins over category-level. A user with no matching policy cannot see the report at all.

get.description: Returns all active report definitions the caller can view. Filter by category to narrow results. Reports the caller cannot view are invisible (not returned with an access-denied flag).

put.description: Only CUSTOM reports can be updated. SYSTEM reports are immutable — clone them first.

delete.description: Only CUSTOM reports can be deleted. SYSTEM reports cannot be deleted.

post.summary: Clone a SYSTEM report into a CUSTOM report
post.description: Creates a new CUSTOM report pre-populated with the source report's config. The user can then edit and save it.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name for the cloned report (defaults to source name + ' (Copy)')

get.summary: List pinned reports for the current user

post.summary: Pin a report to the home page
post.description: Pins are per-user. Regulatory reports (REGULATORY category) cannot be pinned.

post.summary: Run a report — returns JSON result

filters.description: Key-value map of filter values matching the report's config.filters

200.description: Report result with columns, rows, and totalRows

post.summary: Run a report — streams CSV download
Run a report — returns PDF download

get.summary: Get approval groups for entity type

get.description: Returns the current alert thresholds and retention policy for this tenant. Requires AUDIT_VIEW or SETUP_UPDATE.

put.description: Updates alert thresholds and retention period. **Requires SETUP_UPDATE role (System Admin only).**

get.summary: List causes of loss by nature

200.description: Current customer number format configuration (null if not yet configured)

put.summary: Create or update customer number format

includeType.description: Appends IND or CORP; uses separate sequences per type

get.description: Returns the tenant's quote configuration singleton (validity days, premium calculation sequence).

put.description: Updates the quote config singleton. Creates it if it does not exist.

get.description: Returns all active discount types available to underwriters when building quotes.

post.description: Adds a new named discount type. The actual rate/amount is set by the underwriter at quote time.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the discount type. Existing quotes retain the resolved label.

get.description: Returns all active loading types available to underwriters when building quotes.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the loading type. Existing quotes retain the resolved label.
